Metalsmith Plugin MCP Server
MCP server for scaffolding and validating high-quality Metalsmith plugins

Usage:
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server <command> [options]

Commands:
  help                          Show this help message
  version                       Show version information
  server                        Start the MCP server (for AI assistants)
  config                        Show current configuration and setup
  scaffold [name] [description] [path] Create a new Metalsmith plugin
  validate [path] [--functional] Validate plugin against enhanced quality standards
  audit [path] [--fix] [--output=json|markdown] Run comprehensive plugin audit
  batch-audit [path] [--fix] [--output=json|markdown] Run audit on multiple plugins
  configs [path]                Generate configuration files
  show-template [type]          Display recommended configuration templates
  list-templates                List all available templates
  get-template [name]           Get specific template content (e.g., plugin/CLAUDE.md)
  install-claude-md [path] [--replace] [--dry-run] Install CLAUDE.md with AI assistant instructions
  update-deps [path] [--install] [--test] Update dependencies in plugin(s)
  diff-template [path] [--templates=a,b] Diff plugin against current scaffold templates

Note: Commands can be run in guided mode by omitting parameters

Examples:
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server version                   # Show version
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server config                    # Show current setup
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server scaffold my-plugin "Processes my files" ./plugins
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server scaffold                  # Guided mode
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server validate ./metalsmith-existing-plugin # Enhanced quality checks
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server validate ./ --functional # Run tests & coverage
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server audit ./my-plugin       # Comprehensive plugin audit
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server audit ./my-plugin --fix # Audit with automatic fixes
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server batch-audit ./plugins   # Audit multiple plugins
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server configs ./my-plugin
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server show-template release-it  # Show .release-it.json template
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server list-templates            # Show all available templates
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server get-template plugin/CLAUDE.md # Get CLAUDE.md template
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server install-claude-md         # Smart merge CLAUDE.md in current dir
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server install-claude-md --replace # Replace existing CLAUDE.md
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server install-claude-md --dry-run # Preview changes without applying
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server update-deps ./plugins     # Update all plugins
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server update-deps ./my-plugin   # Update single plugin
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server update-deps ./ --install --test # Update, install & test
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server diff-template ./my-plugin # Show drift from latest scaffold
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server diff-template . --templates=plugin/package.json.template # Diff one file

Enhanced Validation Includes:
  • Marketing language detection (flags buzzwords like "intelligent", "seamless")
  • Module system consistency (prevents CJS/ESM mixing that causes errors)
  • Hardcoded values detection (finds values that should be configurable)
  • Performance anti-patterns (objects in functions, redundant utilities)
  • Internationalization readiness (detects English-only outputs)

MCP Server Setup:
  For use with Claude Desktop or Claude Code, run:
  npx metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server server

For more information, visit:
https://github.com/wernerglinka/metalsmith-plugin-mcp-server
